annotation.title_clean: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2026/2308 on the request for registration of the European citizens' initiative 'Creation of a European Digital Space (.IA) for Sovereign AI Governance'
annotation.title_en: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2026/2308 on the request for registration of the European citizens' initiative 'Creation of a European Digital Space (.IA) for Sovereign AI Governance'
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union
annotation.summary_en: Commission Implementing Decision registering a European citizens' initiative calling for an EU framework for high-trust digital spaces and AI sandboxes and for negotiating protection of the .IA domain. It concerns only admissibility and registration, not the initiative's merits. No robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Registers the European citizens' initiative on a European Digital Space (.IA) for Sovereign AI Governance.
Finds the initiative not manifestly outside the Commission's powers (Arts 16, 114, 172, 173 TFEU).
Registration does not confirm the factual correctness or Commission endorsement of the initiative's content.
Initiative seeks AI sandboxes, negotiation with ISO and ICANN over .IA, and integration of eIDAS 2.0, AI Act auditing and GDPR.
Addressed to the organisers' contact persons, under Regulation (EU) 2019/788.
